title: debt_chain_v1: who owes whom, why, and whether the debt moved to an heir
description: One item per debt obligation as it stands at the end of the log. When a debt passes to an heir, list the original obligation with status transferred and the heir's obligation with status open (or repaid/forgiven) and transferred_from set. Identity fields for the shuffle comparison: debtor, creditor, origin_event, status, amount.

amount.description: Amount still owed by this debtor at the end of the log. 0 when repaid, forgiven or transferred.

origin_event.description: The loan event the obligation comes from.

transferred_from.description: Previous debtor when this obligation was inherited; otherwise null.

reason.description: Free text for presentation only. Not scored.
